facts.guard: removal notice is not planning permission or title evidence

facts.scope: agricultural hedgerow cutting and trimming rules
facts.guard: management-rule compliance is separate from removal consent
appeal filing is not a successful outcome
one approval does not replace other required permissions
statutory criteria require exact hedge and current facts

scope_guards: Protected, important and merely existing hedgerows are not interchangeable categories.
The 20 metre, location and importance tests require exact hedge geometry and context.
A removal notice is not a planning permission, felling licence or landowner consent.
The 42-day process and any written response must be checked against the exact notice chronology.
Cutting and trimming restrictions are separate from permanent removal controls.
Hedgerow trees may also require a felling licence or TPO consent.
A retention or replacement notice and an appeal filing are not final permission outcomes.
No score or promotion is written without exact hedge, age, criteria, notice, decision, appeal and related-consent evidence.
